seo_title: The Well | Furnished Monthly Rental in Palm Springs, CA
seo_description: A furnished one-bedroom Palm Springs condo for stays of 28 nights or more. Sleeps two, with a full kitchen, workspace, laundry, and shared pool access.
tagline: A Palm Springs home for a longer stay.
description_heading: Settle in for a month or more.
description_p1: The Well is a furnished one-bedroom condo in Palm Springs for stays of at least 28 nights. It sleeps two, with a full kitchen, workspace, and in-unit laundry.
description_p2: Warm wood, sage walls, and a teal velvet sofa keep the space simple. There’s storage for your clothes and a dishwasher for the meals you make at home.
description_p3: Shared community pool and hot tub access are included. The living room has books and cookbooks for evenings in.
description_p4: Email us your dates and any questions about the setup. We’ll confirm availability and monthly pricing before you book.
